title: Managing special events and parades
description: Special Events like Parades can disrupt the day-to-day traffic on the particular road and thus result in congestion which in turn result in several problems. Thus the traffic lights can play a very crucial role in such scenarios in diverting the traffic on other roads. For Example: Longer green light durations for major thoroughfares leading to the event area can help accommodate the higher volume of vehicles.
dialogue_prompts: 1. Is their a conflict? Yes, every vehicle want to cross the road as soon as possible but they are interrupted by the the congestion caused by the parade. For eg. At intersections or designated crossing points, vehicles and participants may need to share the same space. 2. Is their a common problem to be solved? Yes, both the vehicles and the participants do not want to wait for the other as they cross the road. 3. Is the reason good? No. 4. Negotiationmayberequiredtoaddressconflicts,mitigatedisruptions,andfindpracticalsolutionsthat balance the interests of all stakeholders involved.
peas: 30.6.1 Performance Measure 1. Traffic Flow: Measure the efficiency of traffic flow along parade routes and nearby roadways, aiming to minimize congestion and delays. 3. Safety: Assess the effectiveness of traffic management measures in ensuring the safety of both parade participants and road users. 30.6.2 Enviornment 4.
